verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; Google spend is not converting.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 27 leads at a cost of $146.16 per lead — a cost that more than doubled week-over-week, driven by Google Ads producing only 5 conversions on $2,668 in spend. Meta carried all 27 tracked leads on roughly half the budget, making it the only paid channel performing right now. Your Google Search campaign is being reviewed and restructured this week to bring conversion volume in line with what is being spent. Separately, 269 contacts have entered your pipeline this period but none have advanced to appointments, which points to a routing issue in intake that is being addressed now. If Google performance stabilizes and pipeline routing is corrected, you should see cost per lead begin to come down over the next two to three weeks.
